official_sources.name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons metadata

direct_official_checks: INSPIRE Index Polygons contain freehold registered property locations
the dataset is a subset of HM Land Registry Index Polygons
files are divided by local authority
a polygon on a local-authority boundary appears in both local-authority files
cross-authority presence must not be counted as two parcel identities
partition provenance must be retained through deduplication
no candidate identity is inferred from authority membership alone
quality_effect: Eliminates double counting where one HMLR polygon occurs in two local-authority files.
